$comment: AI-assisted: Claude Fable 5.2 via Claude Code, 2026-11-18: wrote this file for the closed-loop demo comparison (work list 4.1). configs/providers.json is frozen by the pre-registration (evidence/M4/M4.T1/prereg.json), so models that are not study arms live here; tools/closed_loop_run.py reads both files. Same schema (bm.providers/1).

options.thinking: adaptive (field omitted; always on for this model)
options.harness: harness/closed_loop.py AnthropicDriver over the frozen harness/providers/anthropic_messages.py agent_step
options.price_source: Claude API skill bundled with Claude Code (cached 2026-11-03): Claude Fable 5.2 US$8 / US$40 per million input / output tokens, 5-minute cache writes US$10, cache reads US$0.20
options.settings_vs_opus_arm: identical request shape to the frozen claude-opus-5-5 entry (max_tokens 64000, output_config.effort medium, thinking field omitted, no sampling parameters, no tool_choice, the same two cache breakpoints, non-streaming, 900 s client timeout, 7 attempts, 30 turns a step). Differences: the model id; the price; effort medium is one level below this model's default (high), while it is the Opus 5.5 default; no server-side refusal fallback is requested for either model, so a refusal (stop_reason refusal) is a counted harness fallback, not a silent switch to another model
